description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionManager class in the android app module. It verifies correct handling of TLS parameters based on various endpoint host and configuration scenarios, as well as the construction of node connection options including supported features and capabilities.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ConnectionManager's TLS resolution and node connection options.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_prefersStoredPinOverAdvertisedFingerprint
methods.description: Tests that the TLS parameters correctly prioritize stored fingerprint over advertised fingerprint.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_doesNotTrustAdvertisedFingerprintWhenNoStoredPin
methods.description: Ensures that when no stored fingerprint is available, the advertised fingerprint is not trusted.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualRespectsManualTlsToggle
methods.description: Checks the manual TLS toggle respects the manualTlsEnabled flag.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualNonLoopbackForcesTlsWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Verifies that non-loopback manual endpoints require TLS when the toggle is off.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualPrivateLanCanStayCleartextWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Tests that private LAN endpoints can stay cleartext when manual TLS toggle is off.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryTailnetWithoutHintsStillRequiresTls
methods.description: Checks that tailnet discovery endpoints require TLS even without hints.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryPrivateLanWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies that private LAN endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures loopback endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLocalhostWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies localhost endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryAndroidEmulatorWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Checks that Android emulator endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost_onlyTreatsEmulatorBridgeAsLocalWhenAllowed
methods.description: Tests if the emulator bridge IP is treated as local based on the allowEmulatorBridgeAlias parameter.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost_acceptsLanHostsButRejectsTailnetHosts
methods.description: Verifies acceptance of LAN hosts and rejection of tailnet hosts.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryIpv6LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures IPv6 loopback endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryMappedIpv4LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies mapped IPv4 loopback endpoints without hints can stay cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryNonLoopbackIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Checks that non-loopback IPv6 endpoints require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv4WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Verifies that unspecified IPv4 endpoints require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Checks that unspecified IPv6 endpoints require TLS.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesRequestableSmsSearchWithoutSmsCapability
methods.description: Tests node connection options for advertising SMS search when SMS capability is unavailable.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_doesNotAdvertiseSmsWhenSearchIsImpossible
methods.description: Verifies SMS commands and capabilities are omitted when search is impossible.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesSmsCapabilityWhenReadSmsIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks that SMS capability is advertised when read SMS is available.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesSmsSendWithoutSearchWhenOnlySendIsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies SMS send command is advertised when only send is available.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesAvailableNonSmsCommandsAndCapabilities
methods.description: Verifies various sensor and camera capabilities are advertised based on permissions and device features.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsVoiceWakeWithoutMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Ensures VoiceWake capability is omitted if microphone permission is not granted.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsUnavailableCameraLocationAndCallLogSurfaces
methods.description: Verifies that unavailable features like camera, location, and call log are not advertised.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesOnlyAvailableMotionCommand
methods.description: Tests that only available motion commands are advertised based on device capabilities.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsMotionSurfaceWhenMotionApisUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies that motion commands and capabilities are omitted if APIs are unavailable.

methods.name: newManager
methods.description: Helper function to instantiate a ConnectionManager with configurable feature flags for testing.
